note: Every translatable string on each board, in reading order, with its Arabic. kind is text, attr (aria-label, alt, placeholder or title), title (the document title) or js (copy the board script renders). status approved means the owner has seen and approved that Arabic on a board; draft means it was written for this handoff in the same voice and the owner still has to review it. Prices, sizes, codes, initials and the sample store name in Latin letters are not listed because they do not change between languages, except that prices read "3,250 ج.م" in Arabic. Chat-Arabic is Arabic by design and has no English twin.
